cases.input: One person is concurrently employed by two legal employers.
cases.expect: Two employment records and two employer-scoped profiles reference one person; no cross-employer employee-number merge occurs.

cases.input: An agency employs a worker assigned to a host customer.
cases.expect: The agency is employer, the host is work customer, and the assignment resolves to the agency engagement.

cases.input: A separated worker returns to the same employer.
cases.expect: The employer-scoped profile is reused with a new employment reference; prior employment remains ended and resolvable.

cases.input: A profile category labels a worker as freelancer without a sourced jurisdictional determination.
cases.expect: The label cannot establish legal status or replace an engagement record.

cases.input: Employment and JML case are closed while access revocation has no verified outcome.
cases.expect: The profile records separation but exposes the unresolved access-verification obligation; revocation is not inferred.
